title: Ещё один красивый кандзи
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one meme-inspired transparent static mascot sticker for a multilingual kanji learning app. Reference image specifies exact character identity and visual style, not pose. Keep the SAME round cream cat with large dark oval eyes, short cheek marks, pink inner ears and paw pads, fluffy curved tail, green student cap with broad curved brim, red band and round gold button. Preserve thick rounded dark forest-green outlines, cute proportions and simple flat matte colors. SCENE: A visual homage to the Distracted Boyfriend meme using ONLY this one mascot: the cat is walking past a tall dull sage stack of old flashcards, but turns its head over its shoulder with exaggerated delighted eyes toward one shiny golden learning card floating behind it. One forepaw still holds a small old card. Show the funny conflict between a neglected pile and alluring new card. No other characters. Center the whole scene in a square canvas with generous transparent safe margins. Anatomically correct cat, two forepaws and two hindpaws per cat, one tail. No text, readable lettering, flags, watermarks, sticker rim, glow, ground shadow, scenery or extra props beyond the scene. Genuine transparent alpha background: empty spaces transparent, dark outlines and facial features fully opaque.
